questions.prompt: A script that passes ShellCheck with zero warnings is...

options.a: Proven 100% secure and free of vulnerabilities
options.b: Free of the syntax flaws ShellCheck is programmed to detect, but may still contain critical logic and trust flaws

questions.prompt: What happens if you double-quote the argument to `eval` (e.g. `eval "$POST_HOOK"`)?

options.a: It makes the command safe against arbitrary code execution
options.b: It satisfies ShellCheck SC2086, but leaves the code execution vulnerability completely untouched
options.c: It converts the variable into a read-only string

questions.prompt: Why is an unguarded `cd $SRC_DIR` before `tar -czf ... .` dangerous?

options.a: If `cd` fails, the script continues executing and archives whatever directory it happened to be in
options.b: The `cd` command is deprecated in modern Bash
options.c: It causes significant runtime performance degradation
